summary: Join our comprehensive Energy Management training course for oil and gas facilities. Learn to maximize efficiency and reduce costs effectively.
lede: Energy management in oil and gas facilities involves measuring energy use and identifying practical efficiency improvements. For energy and facilities managers, engineers, maintenance teams and sustainability staff, it supports decisions that balance efficiency with production uptime and cost control. Learners explore energy-flow analysis, performance monitoring and benchmarking, process and heat optimization, and building the business case for energy projects.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for a diverse group of professionals involved in the various spectrums of the oil and gas industry, seeking to enhance their energy management practices.
audience: Energy and facilities managers in oil
Oil and gas project managers and site
modules: Introduction to Energy Management in Oil and Gas Facilities
Understanding Energy Flows in Upstream, Midstream, and Downstream Operations
Energy Efficiency Strategies in Process Operations
Fuel Management and Heat Integration Principles
Integrating Energy Management with HSE and ESG Goals
Technology and Innovation in Energy Efficiency
Building the Energy Optimization Business Case
Communication and Leadership in Energy Management
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have a basic understanding of oil and gas operations. Prior experience in operational, engineering, or HSE roles is beneficial but not mandatory. A willingness to engage in hands-on exercises and group discussions is required.
